components.css: .ds-board{background:#0e1a24;border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;color:#fff;max-width:640px}.ds-row{position:relative;isolation:isolate;display:grid;grid-template-columns:54px 1fr auto 34px;gap:0 18px;align-items:center;min-height:62px;padding-right:16px;color:#fff;text-decoration:none}.ds-row::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-1;background:var(--z);clip-path:inset(0 calc(100% - 54px) 0 0);transition:clip-path .45s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-row:hover::before,.ds-row:focus-visible::before{clip-path:inset(0)}.ds-row:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #fff;outline-offset:-3px}.ds-tab{display:grid;place-items:center;align-self:stretch}.ds-label{display:flex;flex-direction:column;font:600 22px/1.15 Geologica,'Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif}.ds-label small{font-size:14px;font-weight:500;color:#a9b7c0;margin-top:.3em}.ds-row:hover small{color:#fff}.ds-yr{padding:2px 8px;border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.22);border-radius:4px;font:600 13px Geologica,'Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:#a9b7c0}.ds-row:hover .ds-yr{color:#fff;border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.7)}.ds-arr{display:grid;place-items:center;width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.25);transition:background-color .3s,color .3s}.ds-row:hover .ds-arr{background:#fff;border-color:#fff;color:var(--z)}

narrative.overview:
The site reads like the signage of a modern hospital. A career is laid out as zones on a lobby directory, each with its own colour and pictogram, and a single painted guide line runs down the whole page through every zone, the way a floor line leads a visitor to a department. Signs carry both languages at once, as Mongolian hospitals do: the active language large, the other set beneath it. Running text shows only the active language.

The ground is a pale, slightly green signage grey with near-black navy sign panels. Colour is a wayfinding tool, never decoration: it appears on zone squares, directory tabs and the guide line, and nowhere else. The audience is senior and professional, so the system stays calm, legible and exact, with dates in fixed tabular plates like room numbers.
keyCharacteristics: Pale signage ground, navy sign panels, four zone colours used only for wayfinding.
Bilingual signs: active language primary, other language beneath at 0.42em (never below 14px).
One continuous guide line through the page, coloured per zone.
Years set as outlined room-number plates in a fixed column.

rules.name: The Wayfinding-Only Rule
rules.body: Zone colours appear only on zone squares, directory tabs and the guide line. Headings, body text, bullets and borders stay neutral.

rules.name: The White-On-Zone Rule
rules.body: Every zone colour must hold white text at 4.5:1 or better, because the board fills a whole row with it on hover.

rules.name: The Two-Language Sign Rule
rules.body: A sign shows both languages; text shows one. Secondary sign text is 0.42em of the sign, never below 14px (13px on the board).

rules.name: The Room Number Rule
rules.body: Every date is set in tabular figures inside an outlined plate, in a fixed-width column (116px) so years scan straight down.

rules.name: The Mounted-Sign Rule
rules.body: Only physical signs (the board, the door plate) cast shadows. Lists, entries and sections never do.

dos: **Do** put every new section on the guide line with its own zone square and bilingual heading.
**Do** write all copy twice, English and Mongolian, as sibling spans.
**Do** set every date in a room plate with tabular figures.
**Do** check new zone colours for 4.5:1 white text before using them on the board.
donts: **Don't** colour headings, bullets or borders with zone colours; colour is for wayfinding only.
**Don't** add check marks, thick top bars or other ornament; arrows are the only ornament.
**Don't** add eyebrow labels above headings or numbered section markers.
**Don't** use panel-text-secondary (#a9b7c0) on a light ground.
**Don't** drop below 14px for secondary sign text.
